meta.name: uniswap-viem
meta.description: EVM blockchain integration using viem and wagmi — wallet connection, contract reads/writes, real-time event subscriptions, multicall, and multi-chain support.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让应用接入区块链网络，读取和写入链上数据。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在开发需要连接区块链的去中心化应用。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to blockchain networks to read and write on-chain data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building dApps that need to interact with EVM blockchains.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能借助 viem 和 wagmi 连接钱包、读写合约、订阅实时事件,并支持 multicall 与多链操作。
howto.when: 当用户提出涉及 EVM 链上交互的请求时触发,例如连接钱包、读写合约等。

say.text: 帮我连接钱包并读取这个地址的USDC余额
订阅这个合约的Transfer事件,有新交易就提醒我
用multicall批量查询这几个池子的储备量
say.note: 将执行批量调用节省请求

howto.what_en: Claude can use viem and wagmi for EVM integration: connect wallets, read/write contracts, subscribe to events, use multicall, and support multiple chains.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for EVM on-chain interactions, e.g., connecting a wallet or reading/writing contracts.

say_en.text: Connect a wallet and read the USDC balance of this address.
say_en.note: Will perform an on-chain read via viem.

say_en.text: Subscribe to the Transfer event of this contract and notify me of new transactions.
say_en.note: Sets up a real-time event subscription.

say_en.text: Use multicall to batch query the reserves of these pools.
say_en.note: Will execute a batched call to save requests.
